# Vendored dependencies

- pinyin-pro 3.29.5: npm package `dist/index.js`, MIT.
- jsPDF 4.2.1: npm package `dist/jspdf.umd.min.js`, MIT.
- hanzi-writer-data 2.0.1: 9,574 character JSON files, Arphic Public License.
- LXGW WenKai Regular: `lxgw/LxgwWenKai/fonts/TTF/LXGWWenKai-Regular.ttf`, downloaded 2026-10-14, OFL.
- Lora Italic variable: `google/fonts/ofl/lora/Lora-Italic[wght].ttf`, downloaded 2026-10-14, OFL.

Licenses are retained in `licenses/`.

- Hanzi Writer 3.5.0: pinned npm dist via jsDelivr, MIT. Uses only the existing local character JSON loader; no runtime CDN requests.
- qrcode-generator 1.4.4: npm package `qrcode.js`, MIT. Draws the “扫码再出一张” footer QR on each page.
